helper_question_agent-brief: What goes in the brief for the agent?
helper_answer_agent-brief: Where: the file, page or address the work is on. Done when: what must be true once it is finished. Constraints: what not to touch. Notes: the rest. Click Edit in the Brief for the agent tile.
helper_question_agent-mark: How do I see what an agent did?
helper_answer_agent-mark: In Activity, an agent's entry is signed with its name, such as Claude, and yours with you. While a timer an agent started is running, a chip there says Claude working with the minutes.
helper_question_agent-token-new: How do I add a token for an agent?
helper_answer_agent-token-new: In the Integrations tab, in the Agent tokens tile, click New token, give it a name, tick its abilities and enter your password. The token is shown only once, so copy it right away.
helper_answer_billed-time-task: Billed time is the hours you charge the client. A task bills its real time unless you click Change next to it in Billing and enter another figure. The month is the sum of its tasks.
helper_question_carried-tasks: What are the tasks from earlier days?
helper_answer_carried-tasks: These are planned tasks of earlier days that were not done. The From earlier days group starts folded, so click it to open it. For today adds the task to today's plan, and Remove in the row's menu takes it off this list.
helper_question_client-filters: How do I narrow the client list?
helper_answer_client-filters: The pills above the list are the statuses: Active, Paused, Former and Archived, and the Cooperation menu picks the kind of cooperation. To search, type into the bar at the top and choose Filter the client list. Clear removes the search.
helper_question_client-report: How do I prepare the month's report?
helper_answer_client-report: In Billing, pick a month that has ended and click Generate a report in the Report tile. You get a draft you can correct. Then Mark as ready, and once you have sent it to the client, Mark as sent.
helper_question_close-day: How do I close the day?
helper_answer_close-day: Stop every timer, then click Close the day. Reopen the day undoes the close, and any new timer opens the day again by itself.
helper_question_close-month: What does Close the month do?
helper_answer_close-month: It closes the month in the hours bank: the figures freeze and the balance carries into the next month. You close a month once it has ended, the oldest open one first. Reopen undoes the latest close.
helper_question_counts-in-report: What does Counts in the report mean?
helper_answer_counts-in-report: Counts in the report decides whether the task's time goes into the client's billing. A new task of a client on a retainer has it on. While a ready or sent report counts the task, the switch does not move.
helper_question_hours-bank: How does the hours bank work?
helper_answer_hours-bank: Each month the client has the balance from previous months plus the package, up to the rollover cap if there is one. Billed time comes off that, and the closing balance carries into the next month.
helper_question_hours-left: How many hours are left in the package?
helper_answer_hours-left: The Hours tile in Overview shows the month's worked hours against the hours available, and how many are free or over the package. At the bottom is the balance the client takes into the next month.
helper_question_hours-to-close: What does Hours to close mean?
helper_answer_hours-to-close: Hours to close are the clients who have every step behind them while their month in the hours bank is still open. Click Close the month in the client's row. When the row says close first, start with the older month.
helper_answer_invoice-draft: The CRM only makes drafts in Infakt. In Billing, Copy invoice copies the group's last invoice with new dates, and Pick invoice sets another template. You check the draft and issue it in Infakt.
helper_question_journal-note: How do I add a note about the client?
helper_answer_journal-note: Open the Journal tab and click New entry. Write the note and save. The entry goes to the top of the Client relationship tile with its date and author.
helper_question_lead-convert: How do I turn a lead into a client?
helper_answer_lead-convert: Move the lead to the Won stage and its page shows Convert to client. The new client gets the lead's company name, or its name without one, its email, phone and notes, and the lead stays linked to it.
helper_question_lead-source-fixed: Why can't I change the source?
helper_answer_lead-source-fixed: The source is set once, when the lead is captured. It shows which channel brings clients, so changing it would rewrite that channel's history.
helper_question_lead-tier: Where does a lead's tier come from?
helper_answer_lead-tier: On the lead's page, tick the factors that fit the lead and save. The points add up to a tier, Hot, Warm or Cold, and next to it you see what to do with the lead next. On the list the Tier pill filters by it.
helper_answer_mark-done: Mark done stops the task's timers and closes it. Mark as not done opens it again.
helper_question_month-close-add: How do I add a client to the close?
helper_answer_month-close-add: In the client's Data tab, in the Month close tile, click Edit. Under Monthly close pick Maintenance site or Agency gig, and set Include in the monthly close to Yes, every month.
helper_answer_month-close-what: The month close is a list of steps per client after the month ends: work on maintained sites, a report or email, and an invoice draft. Beside it is the hours close, which freezes the month in the hours bank.
helper_answer_month-close-who: Your steps are the live deploy of a site and the report or summary email. An agent does the rest, including the database archive, updates, verification, the commit and the invoice draft. The split is fixed.
helper_answer_off-plan: Off plan lists tasks with time today that were not in the plan. They do not count toward the day's plan, and To the plan adds such a task to today's plan.
helper_answer_plan-tomorrow: Click Plan tomorrow, or Edit the plan once tomorrow has tasks. Suggestions offer up to three tasks and For tomorrow adds one. Each pick saves at once, and the full list is under All tasks.
helper_answer_retainer-terms: In Billing, in the Retainer tile: the hours package, rollover, net amount per month and the date it applies from. Change opens the retainer positions. In Overview, the Retainer button on the Hours tile shows them read only.
helper_question_sms-failed: What do I do with a failed SMS?
helper_answer_sms-failed: A failed SMS is never retried on its own. The reason shows under the row, and Send again sends it once more. If SMSAPI did not answer, the text may already have arrived, so check before sending it again.
helper_question_sms-polish-letters: How many characters fit in an SMS?
helper_answer_sms-polish-letters: One Polish letter cuts an SMS from 160 characters to 70. In the Messages tab, under SMS sending, set Polish letters to Without and ą becomes a, so more text fits into one SMS.
helper_answer_task-archive: Archive takes the task off the open task lists, and its time stays in the reports. The task page stays, and Restore from the archive puts it back on the lists.
helper_answer_task-billed-time: Billed time is the hours you charge the client. A task bills its real time unless you give it another figure in the client's Billing. The time entries stay as they are. To see the figure here, turn it on in My profile, in the Tasks tile.
helper_question_task-time: How do I track time on this task?
helper_answer_task-time: Start and Stop time the task live. Log time adds time that already passed. The tile shows today's time and the total.
helper_question_timer-start-stop: How do I start and stop a timer?
helper_answer_timer-start-stop: The Start icon on a row starts a timer on the task, and Stop stops it. Several timers can run at once. You can also stop a running timer with Stop in the left bar, or on a phone in the strip above the bottom menu.
helper_question_today-picks: How do I plan the day?
helper_answer_today-picks: Click Add next to Pick another and take tasks with For today. Five make a full day, but you can add more, and a sixth makes the count warn you. A task planned for another day moves to today.
helper_question_trello-owns-card: What can I change on a Trello task?
helper_answer_trello-owns-card: Title, description, list and checklist change in Trello. In the CRM you tick the task off, write its brief and log time. The sync keeps the brief, but undoes the tick when the card moves back to an active list.
helper_question_waiting-for-you: What does Waiting for you mean?
helper_answer_waiting-for-you: Waiting for you gathers what the client needs from you now: a report to generate, finish or send, an open month close and a failed SMS. For an order it also lists the next dated task and an unpaid invoice.
